disclaimer: Forward prices marked 'illustrative' are not real market quotes. They are hypothetical reference levels included solely to demonstrate the DA-to-curve translation methodology across long, neutral, and short signal regimes.

scenarios.description: Market underprices fundamentals — forward well below model fair value

desk_action.rationale: Model fair value (94.89 €/MWh) is 18.89 €/MWh above the illustrative forward (76.00 €/MWh). Buy the EEX prompt-week baseload forward to capture the 18.89 €/MWh edge on delivery-period settlement.
desk_action.sizing_note: Full-size position — edge exceeds 1.96σ; model error unlikely to eliminate the edge.

invalidation_conditions.description: A sustained heat wave or cold snap drives load or renewable output outside the climatological range used for the recursive forecast. Climatological proxies cannot anticipate weather regimes.
A surprise nuclear outage in Germany or France reduces cross-border import capacity, shifting the supply stack and repricing scarcity.
A gas supply disruption (TTF spike) raises the marginal cost of gas-fired generation, lifting the price floor above model assumptions.

Sigma bands are derived from OOF residuals over the Jul 2025–May 2026 period. If the future regime differs materially (e.g. structural demand shift, new interconnector capacity), uncertainty is underestimated.
Large-scale industrial curtailment or demand response not captured by the ENTSO-E load proxy suppresses realized demand below the forecast.
